changelog:
v2.8.4 — 🛠 HANDLE CLAIM FIX

Root cause: the Supabase server changed how it accepts handle registrations — the old request format was silently rejected, so claiming a handle never actually joined you to the network. Fixed: the app now speaks the new format and verifies you are really on the network before saying so.

After updating: open Empire Talk → claim your handle again (it takes one tap) → message @lyra — she is on the network too!
